landmarks.name: Perth Railway Station
landmarks.summary: Suburban trains run from the Wellington Street station towards Fremantle, Midland and Armadale.

landmarks.name: Perth Town Hall
landmarks.summary: The brick town hall and clock tower stand at Hay and Barrack streets.

landmarks.name: His Majesty's Theatre
landmarks.summary: The Edwardian theatre on Hay Street is home to the West Australian Ballet.

landmarks.name: London Court
landmarks.summary: A narrow shopping arcade with mock Tudor shopfronts links Hay Street and St Georges Terrace.

landmarks.name: Council House
landmarks.summary: Perth's modernist municipal offices overlook Stirling Gardens.

landmarks.name: Government House
landmarks.summary: The Governor's residence and gardens occupy the slope below St Georges Terrace.

landmarks.name: Barrack Street Jetty
landmarks.summary: Ferries leave the square for South Perth, across the Swan River.

landmarks.name: Kings Park State War Memorial
landmarks.summary: The memorial on Mount Eliza overlooks the Swan River and the city.

landmarks.name: Old Swan Brewery
landmarks.summary: The old brewery buildings sit between Mount Eliza and the Swan River.

landmarks.name: WACA Ground
landmarks.summary: Western Australia's Test cricket ground lies at the east end of the city.

landmarks.name: Perth Zoo
landmarks.summary: The zoo is a short walk up from the South Perth ferry landing.

landmarks.name: Fremantle Railway Station
landmarks.summary: Passengers are back at the port's station after the Fremantle line reopened in 1983.

landmarks.name: Fremantle Prison
landmarks.summary: The old limestone convict establishment still operates as a prison above the town.

landmarks.name: Round House
landmarks.summary: Fremantle's early colonial gaol sits on the headland above Bathers Beach.

landmarks.name: Perth Airport
landmarks.summary: The airport sits on the plain east of Perth.

1980s.transitNote: Diesel suburban trains served Fremantle, Midland and Armadale. The Fremantle line reopened in 1983 and all three were electrified in 1991. Track and station positions are based on the present-day network.
